int process_string_data_45(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

void process_compute_result(int arr[], int size) {
    int sum = 0;
    int max = arr[0];
    int min = arr[0];
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        sum += arr[i];
        if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
        if (arr[i] < min) min = arr[i];
    }
    
    int average = sum / size;
    printf("Sum: %d, Avg: %d, Max: %d, Min: %d\n", sum, average, max, min);
}

int process_string_validQueue(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}
